answer: Duplicating a sybil requires forging all three artifacts, and a bonded challenger earns the stake by exposing any reuse. Each agent must stake a unique physical token whose provenance is verified: a marble etched with a serial, a saffron-dyed seal, and a yarrow-fiber cord bound to one identity. Attacker cost scales with scarce materials plus lost bonds, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0102 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
